name: Grilled Cheese
instructions: Butter the bread
Place cheese between slices
Grill until golden brown

name: Ham and Cheese Sandwich
instructions: Spread mayo on one side of one slice of bread
Place ham and cheese on the other slice
Press together and enjoy

name: Turkey and Cheese Sandwich
instructions: Spread mayo on one side of each slice of bread
Layer turkey and cheese between the slices

name: Ham and Turkey Sandwich
instructions: Spread mayo on one side of each slice of bread
Layer ham and turkey between the slices

name: Ham Sandwich
instructions: Spread mayo on one side of each slice of bread
Layer ham between the slices

name: Turkey Sandwich
instructions: Spread mayo on one side of each slice of bread
Layer turkey between the slices

name: Peanut Butter and Jelly Sandwich
instructions: Spread peanut butter on one side of one slice of bread
Spread jelly on one side of the other slice
Press together and enjoy

name: Peanut Butter and Marshmallow Sandwich
instructions: Spread peanut butter on one side of one slice of bread
Spread marshmallow fluff on one side of the other slice
Press together and enjoy
